title: 4C4D: 4 Camera 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: A framework for 4D dynamic scene reconstruction using only four portable cameras. It introduces a Neural Decaying Function to prioritize geometric structure over appearance, preventing overfitting in extremely sparse camera setups.
research_notes: Utilizes MASt3R for dense point cloud initialization since traditional COLMAP fails with such sparse input.

evolution.summary: Published in April 2026 and accepted to CVPR 2026. The project represents a major advancement in 4D Gaussian Splatting by enabling high-fidelity reconstruction from as few as four views.
